input: Pressure wash the back patio before summer

gold.taskTitle: Pressure Wash Back Patio Before Summer
gold.taskDescription: Plan and complete the pressure washing of the back patio in time for summer.

questions.title: What is your target completion date for this?
questions.description: Identify the specific deadline or date the user wants the patio cleaned by.

questions.title: Do you own a pressure washer or need one?
questions.description: Determine whether the user already has equipment or needs to rent or borrow one.

questions.title: What material is the patio surface made of?
questions.description: Identify the surface type (concrete, pavers, brick, wood, etc.) to determine the right pressure settings and cleaning solutions.

questions.title: How large is the patio area in square feet?
questions.description: Get an estimate of the patio size to gauge time and effort required.

questions.title: Are there specific stains or problem areas to treat?
questions.description: Find out if there are oil stains, mold, mildew, algae, or other stubborn spots that need special attention.

questions.title: Will you do this yourself or hire someone?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is a DIY job or if the user plans to bring in a professional service.

questions.title: Is outdoor furniture or anything else on the patio now?
questions.description: Determine if there are items that need to be moved or protected before pressure washing begins.
